decisions.title: Umbra founders Kru and Cal: Making Privacy the Default
decisions.author: Kru and Cal / Lightspeed
decisions.summary: Kru and Cal recount Umbra’s founding and explain its then-current MPC/ZK architecture, shielded pools, confidential balances and SDK strategy. They discuss selective disclosure, deposit screening and MetaDAO accountability. The wallet is described as a restricted mainnet beta; public release and institutional integrations remain prospective. Later V2 coverage qualifies this historical architecture.
